label: Text 1
transcript: The final Unit. The Abitur is in two months. Today's task: compile a portfolio of six pieces from Klasse 11-13, write a 400-word reflection, deliver a 5-minute graduation talk, and write a 300-word forward letter to the post-Abitur self. Mr. Yilmaz said, characteristically: the talk is the celebration; the letter is the receipt.
